pages.title: Coherence Stabiliser
pages.text: A humming lattice that keeps my wavefunction from decohering into a thousand slightly different versions of me. Normally the environment measures a body constantly; this device shelters me from enough of that scrutiny to stay one thing. It feels heavier when I think about it too hard.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Quantum Foam I watched my own outline blur into overlapping drafts. I braided an entangled photon pair through a quantum field lattice and a spin foam lattice on a chronosteel frame, so that it carries the decoherence away from me instead.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Quantum Gravity.
